stage: Stage C — frozen oracle + final statistical gate
status: DECISION REQUIRED — frozen epoch-set semantics conflict for ATT-LTE-driving e6 and TMobile-LTE-driving e3

issue.what: Two shared-valid retained replay epochs have no frozen regime label because they are the native downlink traces' final partial epochs.
why: The frozen v3 oracle prereg defines T_fixed over 'retained shared-valid epochs' (replay-sliced; §22.63 freezes epoch slicing over max(up,down)).
The frozen regime classifier labels only full 120 s epochs of the NATIVE downlink trace (final partial excluded); the oracle's transition cost uses the entered epoch's frozen regime label.
cmd/oracle rejects a retained epoch without a label; no frozen rule defines a label for epochs beyond the native downlink trace.

The Stage-C task lists 'native downlink trace semantics' and 'final partial epoch excluded' as frozen epoch rules, but the literal retention rule ('retained shared-valid epochs') conflicts for these two epochs.

option_A.name: Native downlink trace semantics (recommended): retained = shared-valid full native-downlink epochs
option_A.exclusions: ATT e6 and TMobile-LTE e3 excluded as native final partial epochs (no frozen regime label); all other exclusions unchanged

option_B.name: Literal 'retained shared-valid epochs' reading: ATT/TMobile-LTE cannot yield a valid H (no frozen label) → FINAL STATISTICAL GATE NOT EVALUABLE
option_B.note: no frozen rule can label the affected epochs; inventing a label is a methodological decision not in the freeze

recommendation: Option A: apply the frozen 'native downlink trace semantics' + 'final partial epoch excluded' rules; the gate outcome is FAIL under both options, but A yields a defined final gate evaluation.
